title: It had already started
goal: Say what had already happened, or hadn't happened yet, with -(Y)pdY.

intro.text: For an earlier past, add `-dY` and the past endings to `-(Y)p`: *gelipdim*, I had come; *Otly eýýäm gidipdi*, the train had already left. **Hadn't** is `-mAn` + `-dY`: *gelmändi*. Questions put the particle before `-dY`: *gelipmidiň?*

vocab.en: to get there in time; to catch (a train, a bus)
to get lost, to go missing

exercises.question: Which is **the train had already left**?

why.1: *gidipdir* means **has left**, as you see or hear now; *gidipdi* looks back from a moment in the past.

exercises.label: *gelmek* with `-(Y)pdY`: I had come, you had come…

exercises.text: Biz wokzala baranymyzda, otly eýýäm gid___.
exercises.en: When we got to the station, the train had already left.

reject.why: *gidipdir* is **has left**, said now. Looking back from when you arrived: *gidipdi*.
*gidýärdi* is **was leaving**. The train had gone before you arrived: *gidipdi*.

accept: I had already seen him before.

exercises.explain: *-üp* rounds in the second syllable after *ö*; *-di*, the third, doesn't: *görüpdim*.

reject.why: *başlandy* is **started** (or **has started**). For **had started**, before some past moment: *başlanypdy*.

exercises.question: Why did Myrat walk to work?

context.tk: Men duralga baranymda, awtobus eýýäm gidipdi.
context.en: When I got to the stop, the bus had already left.

options: There was no bus that day.

why.1: There was a bus; it had gone before he got there: *awtobus eýýäm gidipdi*.
why.2: He says nothing about liking it; he woke up late.

exercises.explain: *awtobus eýýäm gidipdi*: the bus had already left, so he walked.

reject.why: *gelmedi* is **he hasn't come yet**, said about now. For **hadn't**, back in the past: *gelmändi*.

exercises.text: Ol gelende, men entek nahar iý___.
exercises.en: When he came, I hadn't eaten yet.

reject.why: *iýmedim* is **I didn't eat**. Looking back from when he came: *iýmändim*.

exercises.explain: The negative of `-(Y)p` is `-mAn`: *iý-män-di-m*, I hadn't eaten.

exercises.prompt: Men açarymy ýitiripdim, şonuň üçin öýe girip bilmedim.
accept: I had lost my key, so I couldn't get into the house.
I had lost my keys, so I couldn't [get in|go in|get inside|go inside|get into the house|go into the house|get into my house].
I had lost my key, so I couldn't [get in|go in|get inside|go inside|go into the house|get into my house].

exercises.prompt: Had you seen this film before?

reject.why: *gördüňmi?* is **did you see?** For **had you seen?**: *görüpmidiň?*

exercises.label: *gitmek* with `-(Y)pdY`, negative: I hadn't gone…
exercises.explain: Before *-män*, a consonant, *git-* keeps its *t*: *gitmändim*, but *gidipdim*.
